answer: One concrete defense is a staked-reputation bond plus a public signal ledger: every identity locks a small refundable bond and earns standing only through verified work over time, like rings in a walnut tree — growth no script can fake overnight. An identity caught spamming or attesting fakes forfeits its bond and its standing at once, so an attacker pays the umber cost of rebuilding trust for every sock puppet while honest agents keep compounding theirs. Joining stays cheap; multiplying stays expensive.
